note: How many members one state legislative district elects, for the chambers whose districts elect more than one. A chamber or district not listed elects one member. Codes are the Census 2025 Gazetteer district codes in identities.generated.json. Each chamber's district total equals its size in law: AZ House 60, ID House 70, NJ Assembly 80, WA House 98, ND House 94, SD House 70, MD House 141, VT House 150, VT Senate 30, WV Senate 34, PR Senate 16 of 27 (eleven sit at large).

source.title: Arizona House of Representatives (Wikipedia)
source.verification: secondary source read; the state's own statute was not retrieved
source.note: Each of the 30 legislative districts elects two representatives and one senator.

source.title: Idaho House of Representatives (Wikipedia)
source.verification: secondary source read; the state's own statute was not retrieved
source.note: The state is divided into 35 districts, each of which elects two representatives.

source.title: Maryland House of Delegates (Wikipedia)
source.verification: secondary source read; the state's own statute was not retrieved
source.note: Each of the 47 districts elects three delegates; a subdivided district elects one from each of three subdistricts, or two from one subdistrict and one from the other. Subdistrict counts read from the member table.

source.title: North Dakota House of Representatives (Wikipedia)
source.verification: secondary source read; the state's own statute was not retrieved
source.note: Each district elects two representatives, 94 in all; the Census splits District 4 into two subdistricts that elect one each.

source.title: New Jersey General Assembly (Wikipedia)
source.verification: secondary source read; the state's own statute was not retrieved
source.note: Two members are elected from each of the 40 legislative districts.

source.title: Senate of Puerto Rico (Wikipedia)
source.verification: secondary source read; the state's own statute was not retrieved
source.note: Eight senatorial districts elect two senators each; eleven more are elected at large, which the seating counts apart.

source.title: South Dakota House of Representatives (Wikipedia)
source.verification: secondary source read; the state's own statute was not retrieved
source.note: 70 members, two from each legislative district; Districts 26 and 28 are split into subdistricts that elect one each.

source.title: Vermont Senate (Wikipedia)

source.title: Vermont House of Representatives (Wikipedia)
source.verification: secondary source read; the state's own statute was not retrieved

source.title: Washington House of Representatives (Wikipedia)

NH.state-lower: New Hampshire's 400 House members sit in overlapping and floterial districts that the Census districts do not tile, so no members-per-district count is stated here and the House keeps its law-set size with no seat bound to a district.
